question:
Simplify the following expression.

[7 ÷ 2 × (8.35 + 1.3 + 2.42)]
solution:
Concept Used:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e54636ed411e889d1916f3aa2f06c5b9166f427a3a8425c3cbc9a3f3f9273545.png] 

**Solution:**

⇒ 7 ÷ 2 × (8.35 + 1.3 + 2.42)

⇒ 7 ÷ 2 × 12.07

⇒ 3.5 × 12.07 = 42.245

**Therefore, the simplified result of the given expression is 42.245.**
